name: MultiplayerHub
author: z-eduard005
description: MultiplayerHub - free, decentralized Minecraft server provisioning program, that uses p2p networking and automatic host election to eliminate the need for dedicated server infrastructure.

scripts.pkg-handle: pkg build/main.js -o build/MultiplayerHub.exe -t node18-win-x64 && node scripts/set-win-icon.js && pkg build/main.js -o build/MultiplayerHub -t node18-linux-x64 && chmod +x build/MultiplayerHub
scripts.build: npm run ts-handle && npm run pkg-handle
scripts.release: node scripts/bump-version.js && npm run build && node scripts/release.js
scripts.test: npm run build && cp build/MultiplayerHub ~/Downloads/MultiplayerHub && echo '' | ~/Downloads/MultiplayerHub
